name: Editor Window
description: An editor-window format: a big code window with file tabs, line numbers, syntax colors, typed lines and a blinking cursor, terminals that print output, diff lines in green and red, and STEP badges. Monospace everywhere, a dark Dracula-like palette, CRT-style scanlines and terminal-clear transitions. No emoji. This is a format (look, camera, motion and layout), not a fixed subject: every video brings new subjects.
prompt_hint: Write 8-14 scenes (4-6 s each), one step per scene. Set title.number to the step number and title.kicker to the file or command (e.g. src/app.ts, npm run dev); title.main is what the step does. Most scenes have one code (max 8 lines of 48 chars; start lines with '+ ' or '- ' to show a diff) or terminal element (lines starting with '$' are typed commands, the rest is output), optionally plus a callout or badge. Use checklist for recaps and compare for wrong vs right. Never use emoji. Draw new subjects every video: invent the icons, svg sketches and drawing elements for this topic, and never reuse the example spec's scenery, objects or wording.
